placements.title: Timing markdowns during active afternoon traffic while synchronizing shelf cards to eliminate till surprises
placements.frame: How should day-old markdowns and shelf-edge pricing be timed and synchronized to maximize sales before closing and ensure checkout transparency?
placements.why: Ines and Caleb establish an operational policy that shifts day-old loaf markdowns to 2 PM to capture customer foot traffic before closing, pairing the timing rule with immediate shelf-card updates to prevent till discrepancies.
